key_insight: Guidance in diffusion/flow generative models often breaks probability conservation and pushes samples off the learned manifold; this paper derives a continuity-equation view and introduces a probability-conserving flow guidance that preserves mass and keeps guided samples on the generative manifold.
problem_solved: Existing guidance heuristics (e.g., Classifier-Free Guidance) are simple linear mixes of velocities/scores that ignore the underlying continuity geometry, causing loss of probability mass, off-manifold samples and degraded fidelity under strong guidance.
method: Analyze guidance through the continuity equation to reveal how naive velocity/score extrapolation violates probability conservation and alters the learned density flow.
Derive a corrected flow-guidance formulation that enforces mass-conservation constraints (a probability-conserving vector field) when steering model trajectories toward conditions.
Provide a practical algorithm to apply the correction in diffusion and flow-based samplers, reducing off-manifold drift while remaining efficient and compatible with existing pipelines.
impact: Enables stronger, more reliable conditioning for diffusion and flow models without sacrificing sample fidelity or diversity, allowing practitioners to apply aggressive guidance for alignment tasks (e.g., text/image conditioning) with fewer artifacts and better probabilistic consistency.
visual_elements: Schematic of the continuity equation: density + velocity field illustrating mass flow and where naive guidance injects divergence
Before/after manifold projection scatterplots showing off-manifold drift with standard guidance vs. on-manifold samples with probability-conserving guidance
Flowchart comparing classic CFG/extrapolation (linear velocity mix) to the proposed probability-conserving correction
Performance plot (e.g., FID or accuracy vs. guidance strength) demonstrating stability and improved metrics under strong guidance
paper_authors: Parsa Esmati, Junha Hyung, Amirhossein Dadashzadeh, Jaegul Choo, Majid Mirmehdi
